title: Answer key
description: The documents of the spot check of a locked part (ADR-0019, C11). `kind` tells them apart. `spotcheck` (E9a): `W/parts/<part>/spotcheck.json`, written by `harness part spotcheck`: the sampled `seen` rows of one part at one part hash, with where each value is read. `harness part answer-key` records a verdict only for a row of this file whose `part_hash` is the part's current hash. `answer_key` (E9b): `W/answer-key.json`, written by `harness part answer-key` only: the engineer's verdicts on sampled rows, each under the key (part, file, sheet, mark or subject in NFC, casefolded and single-spaced, field) and never a finding id, so a reread with new ids is scored by `harness part score`.

part_hash.description: The part hash the sample was drawn at (`part_receipts.part_hash`).

n.description: The requested sample size (`--n`, default 5); a small pool gives all its rows, and one row per LISTED field can exceed it.

rows.description: In the order recorded; a new verdict on a key sets the earlier active one to `superseded`.

sheet.description: Null when the row was on no sheet.

subject.description: The normalised (NFC, casefolded, single-spaced) mark or subject of the row.

row.description: The row id at the time of the sample; information only, never part of the key.

correct.description: The value the drawing gives; set exactly when the verdict is `wrong`.

engineer_text.description: The engineer's words, kept as given.

value_shown.description: The value the sample showed the engineer; the expected value of an `ok` verdict.

part_hash.description: The part hash of the sample the verdict judged (`spotcheck.part_hash`): the reading it was about.

seed.description: The seed of that sample: with the hash it names the draw, so a verdict shopped across seeds shows.

value.description: The value as the part's row gives it, verbatim.

file.description: Null when the row names no file.

sheet.description: Null when the row is on no sheet (a cluster) or names no file.

sheet_number.description: Text of the manifest `number_entry` of the sheet; null when none, or when the text is blocked or not printed.

sheet_title.description: Text of the manifest `title_entry` of the sheet; null as `sheet_number`.

view.description: Text of the row's `view.heading_entry`; null when none (a bbox view too) or when the text is blocked or not printed.

entries.description: The entry ids the row cites; the form quotes their texts.

findings.description: The finding ids the row cites.
